'''Blue Four''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fourth member of Blue Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Four.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blue Four was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]], one of his [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|squadron's]] few members to survive the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].<ref name="SR" />

Several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] also flew under the call sign Blue Four, including [[Thurlow Harris]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="RA" /> [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]],<ref name="I146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref> and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] while [[Battle of Kothlis|protecting]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot with the call sign Blue Four was a member of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]]'s [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|squadron]] stationed at [[Folor Base]]. During the [[Battle of Folor|base's evacuation]], "Blue Four" was separated from a squadronmate using the call sign [[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]], and mistakenly believed that "Blue Three" had been killed in battle.<ref name="XWWS" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Alexandra Winger]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|recurring dream]] in which she flew an X-wing as Blue Four.<ref name="MtZ">{{JournalCite|3|Mission to Zila}}</ref> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> after Winger had joined the New Republic, Blue Four was the call sign of her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], [[Chaz Hunter]].<ref name="SoG">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text="Shades of Gray"|int=Shades of Gray|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] identifies [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]], the film's [[Red Six/Legends|Red Six]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> as Blue Four,<ref name="ANHn">''[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]''</ref> while the [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic adaptation]] gives the call sign to [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D. Branon]],<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> who is [[Red Four/Legends|Red Four]] in the final film.<ref name="ANH" />
